page.overview:
Who is Susan Hoffman?

Susan Hoffman is an archaeologist whose investigations led her to encounter Action Force.

Susan Hoffman was part of a group exploring the Roman sewers that have survived under London. Whilst searching they discovered a giant metal creature in the sewers. The robot hit the wall, causing the tunnel to collapse and only Hoffman survived. She returned with a team from Action Force where they encountered the Autobot Blades, then discovered that the creature was the Decepticon Transformer Megatron. Hoffman and the Action Force team rapidly withdrew from the sewers. She then left the scene of the action.
